Package com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure

package com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure
The implementations of the ports, and the wiring that chooses between them.
  • State: InMemorySessionRepository and InMemoryConnectedFoldersRepository keep copies in memory and enforce the optimistic version check; InMemoryUploadStore holds uploads.
  • Plumbing: InMemorySessionEventStream fans events out to listeners and VirtualThreadBackgroundRunner runs long work off the request thread.
  • Fakes that stand in for the real things so the app runs with nothing installed: FakeSandboxAgent, FakeSandboxTransfer and FakeDocumentCatalog, plus the demo content in DemoDataSeeder.
  • Selection: Adapters picks each port's implementation from harness.sandbox.mode and harness.documents.mode.

The real adapters are in the sub-packages sbx (Docker Sandboxes) and graph (OneDrive).

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Adapters
    Chooses the implementation of each external port from configuration, so the same build can run against fakes or real sandboxes: harness.sandbox.mode: fake or sbx (agent and transfer) harness.documents.mode: fake or graph (document catalog) The adapter producers are @Startup: an application-scoped bean is otherwise created on first use, which would let a misspelt mode or missing credentials go unnoticed until the first request.
    DemoData
    The demo content from the prototype: the OneDrive folder library and five seeded conversations.
    DemoDataSeeder
    Loads the prototype's demo conversations at startup (turn off with harness.seed-demo-data=false), and connects its first three demo folders too, but only when the document catalog is the fake one: a real OneDrive has no such folders.
    FakeDocumentCatalog
    A stand-in for OneDrive that serves the prototype's folder library, so the app runs with no Microsoft account.
    FakeSandboxAgent
    A stand-in for the sandbox agent that answers with the same canned reply as the prototype: it "reads" each attached file, "computes" one calculation, and returns a short summary plus a table when files were attached.
    FakeSandboxTransfer
    A stand-in transfer that reports the two stages the prototype shows ("Packaging context", then the transfer) and waits between them, in either direction.
    InMemoryConnectedFoldersRepository
    Keeps each user's connected folders in memory, with the same copy-and-version rules as the session store.
    InMemorySessionEventStream
    Delivers session events to the listeners subscribed to that session, on the publishing thread.
    InMemorySessionRepository
    Keeps sessions in memory.
    InMemoryUploadStore
    Keeps uploaded files in memory, keyed by session and file name.
    Pauses
    Sleeping that the fake adapters use to imitate real work.
    VirtualThreadBackgroundRunner
    Runs background work on virtual threads, which suits the blocking calls agent turns and sandbox transfers make.
